svg.title: Private originals, versioned templates and derived PDFs
svg.desc: Original uploads remain private and byte-for-byte intact. Parsed datasets and saved mapping profiles combine with a concrete template version in a generation job. The job creates derived PDFs and a provenance manifest. Address-page derivation also creates a new document. Applicable validation, review and approval remain necessary before a separate dispatch.
